title: Appealing my infraction

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

Your ban was for excessive infractions, which isn't a one time crime such as hacking. Excessive infractions means exactly what it says on tin: you've had so, so, so many chances and you've completely ignored them. You'll probably have to wait 10 months to even stand a chance of appeal.
Sorry :(
-Denied

Regards,
Aura
